title: eBay Sold Listings Input
description: Pull eBay sold and completed listings by keyword or category. Real sale prices. No login. Pay per sold listing.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search the eBay sold-items index. Each query runs as one search. Examples: 'pokemon charizard psa 9', 'omega seamaster', 'nike dunk low panda size 10'.

categoryIds.title: eBay category IDs
categoryIds.description: Optional eBay category IDs to constrain searches. Each category combines with each query. Find IDs at https://www.isoldwhat.com or the eBay category tree.

conditions.title: Item condition
conditions.description: Filter by condition. Empty includes everything.

minPrice.title: Minimum sold price
minPrice.description: Drop listings sold below this price. Currency matches the chosen region.

maxPrice.title: Maximum sold price
maxPrice.description: Drop listings sold above this price. Zero or empty disables the cap.

daysBack.title: Lookback window in days
daysBack.description: Drop listings sold more than this many days ago. eBay's sold index typically returns the last 90 days regardless. Default 90.

region.title: eBay region
region.description: Regional eBay storefront. Determines currency and search index.

maxListingsPerSource.title: Max listings per source
maxListingsPerSource.description: Stop paginating for a given query or category once this many sold listings have been collected. Higher numbers add latency and proxy cost.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: Number of search pages processed in parallel. Three is a safe default for eBay.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential is required at any meaningful volume.
